note_excerpt: Muwop or ‘Wop is an O’Block member who was arrested with 5 other Chicago men for the murder of rapper and rival gang member FBG Duck. Before the arrest, Muwop had started his rap career and could be seen hanging with Lil Durk and other OTF members.
